title: Audit CommandCenter deployment-source parity before coordination-card implementation
description: Run the read-only, evidence-bounded deployment-source parity audit recommended by KICK-01. Establish which checkout or installer template actually updates the operator Command Center, identify any unavailable source boundary or mismatch, and shape a later UI task only after the evidence is sufficient. Do not edit UI, deployment state, policy, authority, or TASK-227.
acceptance_criteria: The audit records candidate live and template source locations, observed accessibility, and evidence for or against each as the deployable source without modifying any source.
The audit documents the actual or unavailable update and verification path, including the exact uncertainty that prevents a deployment claim.
The audit lists only evidence-supported future UI output paths and names discrepancies that must be resolved before implementation.
The audit makes no UI, deployment, policy, authority, shared-state, or TASK-227 change and produces a durable recommendation for the next lifecycle test.
